results.name: native transaction concurrent consumers and reconstructed replay retain one terminal change and original ciphertext
native pending then expired original run and deliberately lost commit acknowledgement recover without execution
native current cancellation settles event only and preserves prior completed run receipt

limits: Callback invalidation races were synthetic-only; this script does not claim cloud contention semantics.
Lost acknowledgement was injected after an actual emulator transaction commit.
Authority creation, new run claim, scheduler, account/device migration and production writers remain unimplemented.

nativeEmulator.versionBoundary: Three native SDK/emulator stages passed before the final future-due rejection guard and terminal-no-op comment. The final rejection guard was checked with the targeted synthetic negative group and final scoped typing; native smoke was not rerun. Reviewer considered another native pass unnecessary.
nativeEmulator.firstAttempt: Emulator and client were started in separate exec process/network namespaces; client could not reach that listener. Both sessions were interrupted (exit 130) without test results. Retried once in a single exec namespace with original loopback guard, no network expansion.
nativeEmulator.cleanup: Synthetic documents removed, SDK terminated, shell EXIT trap stopped emulator; JVM logged server shut down.
nativeEmulator.expectedSdkRetry: Emulator logged a transaction lock timeout while concurrent consumers ran; native SDK retry completed successfully with one terminal change. Not real-cloud contention evidence.

reviewerSupplement.result: Cancelled first constituent plus active second constituent settled the event completed; both work ciphertexts unchanged; reconstructed processor replay left the complete database unchanged.

preservedToolingFailure: One Python patch attempt had a doubled workdir-relative prefix and exited FileNotFoundError before source modification (chunk 033049). Same command still ran the prior-candidate emulator smoke; subsequent patch used correct paths.
